 Julianne Moore, Josh Brolin and Daisy Ridley Lead the Buzziest Titles at AFM
 THR’s 2026 AFM Hot List spans star-led packages, international genre plays, animation and prestige dramas, all hunting for an audience in a changing independent landscape

 Scott Roxborough

 (L to R): Stars with projects looking for buyers at AFM 2026: Patrick Schwarzenegger, Daisy Ridley, Josh Brolin, Renée Zellweger, LaKeith Stanfield, Julianne Moore

 The American Film Market’s 47th edition, taking place Nov. 10-15 at the Fairmont Century Plaza, AMC Century City and The Pavilion in Los Angeles, arrives at a moment of near-total disruption for the independent film business. The models that have long underpinned financing, production and distribution are in flux, squeezed by consolidation, changing audience habits and a market in which the traditional routes to getting a film made and seen are no longer a given.
 But the upheaval is also opening doors. A new generation of online creators-turned-filmmakers — Curry “Obsession” Barker, Kane “Backrooms” Parson and Mark “Iron Lung” Fischbach among them — is proving that audiences can be built outside the traditional system and carried onto screens.
 “Oddly, every independent success is still seen as a fluke, or gets put in a bucket,” says Jackie Brenneman, the new head of IFTA, which runs AFM. “What’s not being seen is that almost none of these films should have happened, because the structure of the business doesn’t support independent film. That they’ve broken through the way they have is just the tip of the iceberg of demand. Once we build the infrastructure to connect audiences with the stories they want across all different screens, the numbers are going to be much bigger.”
 That sense of untapped demand is echoed by international sellers, some of whom are returning to the market after time away. Among them is South Korea’s Finecut, back at AFM after several years with the animated feature Long Long Night , from Korean director Kyu Bock Youm, which follows a rhino and a penguin as they journey across the wilderness together. “As one of the last markets of the year, AFM is an important opportunity to introduce titles launched after Cannes to buyers, particularly for North and Latin America,” says Finecut sales manager JD Kim. “Considering the trajectory from Parasite to K-Pop Demon Hunters , I believe global interest in Korean culture and content remains strong.”
 THR ’s 2026 Hot List of the titles generating buzz at AFM spans star-led packages, international genre plays, animation, prestige dramas and films at various stages of production. The common thread is a search for projects — and business models — that can find their audience in a rapidly changing independent landscape.
 ‘Almost You’
 Image Credit: Lisa O'CONNOR / AFP, Gareth Cattermole, Stephanie Augello 
 Almost You 
 DIRECTOR Matt Lipsey
 STARS Juno Temple, Joey King, James McAvoy
 BUZZ AI and grief collide in this high-concept tale about a robotics engineer mourning her younger sister, who feeds years of messages, videos and social media posts into an AI replica of her. The invention brings comfort — at first — before forcing her to confront a thorny question: if you could bring someone back, should you? A trio of Temple, King and McAvoy gives the timely premise some marquee value for buyers.
 SALES Bankside Films, UTA
 ‘ A Speck in the Sea ‘
 Image Credit: Daniele Venturelli/WireImage, Katie FLORES / AFP 
 A Speck in the Sea 
 DIRECTOR Orlando Von Einsiedel
 STARS Josh Brolin, Jeremy Renner
 BUZZ Oscar-winning documentarian Von Einsiedel (The White Helmets) makes his fiction debut with this based-on-a-true survival tale of Johnny Aldridge (Brolin), a Montauk lobster fisherman who falls off his fishing boat in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean in the dead of night, with his best friend Anthony Sosinski (Renner), asleep below deck.
 ‘Breakwater’
 Image Credit: Daniele Venturelli, Mike Marsland/WireImage 
 Breakwater 
 DIRECTOR Luc Walpoth
 STARS Olga Kurylenko, Alex Pettyfer
 BUZZ Action thrillers are a go-to at any AFM, which bodes well for this neo-noir project, about a woman trapped in a toxic marriage (Kurylenko) whose plan to blackmail her rich sadistic husband (Pettyfer) goes horribly wrong, landing her and her accomplice in a fight for survival on the high seas.
 SALES WestEnd Films
 ‘Control’
 Image Credit: Stefania D'Alessandro, Gareth Cattermole 
 Control 
 DIRECTOR Robert Schwentke
 STARS James McAvoy, Julianne Moore
 BUZZ One of the higher-profile star-driven actioners on offer at AFM, this feature, from the director of Red, features McAvoy as a man who wakes up one morning with an untraceable device planted in his head and must follow a mysterious voice’s instructions or devastating consequences.
 SALES Studiocanal
 ‘Darlington’
 Image Credit: Gareth Cattermole, Dia Dipasupil, Manoli Figetakis 
 Darlington 
 DIRECTOR Sascha Gervasi
 STARS Renée Zellweger, Dominic Sessa, Peter Dinklage
 BUZZ Zellweger plays a faded television actress invited to reprise her most famous role — only this time in the real world. Her host (Sessa) is a reclusive tech billionaire who has restored an English country estate and lives there as if it were 1923. As she settles into his carefully controlled fantasy, the line between illusion and reality starts to blur. Alexander Payne is on board as executive producer, which should add some cachet to the package.
 SALES Rocket Science, CAA
 ‘The Face of Horror’
 Image Credit: Paul Archuleta, Aurore Marechal 
 The Face of Horror 
 DIRECTOR Anna Biller
 STARS Jonah Hauer-King, Kristine Froseth, Leo Suter
 BUZZ Biller’s gothic horror takes its cue from Yotsuya Kaidan , Japan’s most famous ghost story and a cornerstone of Japanese horror, adapted more than 30 times, including by Takashi Miike as Over Your Dead Body in 2014. Set amid war and plague, the story follows a knight who kills a landowner, marries his daughter and vows to avenge the very crime he committed. When he betrays her, his wife returns from the grave to exact revenge, drawing his squire and her sister into the supernatural reckoning.
 SALES Embankment Films
 ‘Falcon’
 Image Credit: Courtesy of @DR 
 Falcon 
 DIRECTOR Marco Bellocchio
 STARS Pierfrancesco Favino, Louis Garrel, Benedetta Cimatti, Barbara Ronchi, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi
 BUZZ Bellocchio turns his lens on the boardroom with this drama about Sergio Marchionne (Favino) and his bid to rescue Fiat from the brink of collapse. Framed as a financial thriller with a psychological edge, the film tracks Marchionne’s battles with General Motors and Chrysler and his mentorship of heir John Elkann (Garrel), while counting the personal cost of saving an industrial empire.
 SALES Rai Cinema International Distribution
 ‘Feed’
 Image Credit: Courtesy of Getty 
 Feed 
 DIRECTOR Leslye Headland 
STAR Rosamund Pike
 BUZZ This new project, which Pike will also produce, could provide an injection of socially-conscious body horror in the vein of The Substance for indie buyers. Inspired by 2022 Finnish feature Hatching , it stars Pike as a Muminfluencer desperate to make her gymnast daughter an online sensation. But when she turns to a suspicious supplement to help her along, monstrous things begin to happen.
 SALES The Veterans, CAA Media Finance
 ‘Found Alive’
 Image Credit: XYZ Films 
 Found Alive 
 DIRECTOR Carlota Pereda
 STARS Chloë Grace Moretz, Rupert Friend
 BUZZ Genre buyers get a festival-tested option here: the thriller opened the 2026 Sitges Film Festival ahead of its AFM outing. Ten years after escaping a sadistic captor, a young woman agrees to mentor a newly rescued survivor. When the girl’s story points to other missing victims, she is drawn into a deadly game of cat-and-mouse. The English-language debut of Piggy director Pereda is adapted from Carla Norton’s Edge of Normal book series.
 SALES XYZ Films; CAA Media Finance, XYZ Films
 ‘Get Rid of It’
 Image Credit: Tiffany Rose, Lionel Hahn, Brianna Bryson 
 Get Rid of It 
 DIRECTOR Ry Russo-Young
 STARS Daisy Ridley, Sosie Bacon, Simon Rex
 BUZZ A one-night stand leaves Harper with something unexpected growing inside her in this horror thriller, which sends her and her estranged sister on a desperate search for medical help. With the man from the encounter, religious fanatics and, eventually, the FBI all in pursuit, the sisters must confront both the creature and the wounds that drove them apart. The film is scheduled to shoot in February 2027.
 SALES Upgrade, CAA Media Finance, Range Select
 ‘Gods Don’t Give Gifts’
 Image Credit: AGC Marketing 
 Gods Don’t Give Gifts 
 DIRECTOR Zack London
 STARS Richard Cotton, Sam Dale, Ben Kersley
 BUZZ Add another name to the roster of online creators making the leap to features: YouTuber Zack London ( Gossip Goblin) makes his debut with this animated sci-fi horror anthology, set in a future where transhumanism has pushed humanity far beyond recognition. Across four stories, ordinary people turn to strange new technologies to satisfy primal urges, exposing a widening rift between body and mind.
 SALES AGC Studios
 ‘It’s Alright’
 Image Credit: Paras Griffin, Mike Marsland 
 It’s Alright 
 DIRECTOR Scott Stewart
 STARS Paul Bettany, Asha Banks, Colin Firth, Gugu Mbatha-Raw
 BUZZ A Brit feel-good comedy with a strong music hook, this feature from Legion and Dark Skies director Stewart sees Bettany playing an aging rock star, with real-life pop singer Banks as his estranged daughter, an aspriring singer-songwriter. With a score produced by Marius de Vries, music producer on La La Land , CODA and Moulin Rouge!, this package should have AFM buyers humming along.
 SALES Protagonist Pictures, CAA Media Finance
 ‘I’m With Stupid’
 Image Credit: Jenna Berman, Alexandra Carillo-Vaccino, Oriana Layendecker 
 I’m With Stupid 
 DIRECTOR Hannah Pearl Utt
 STARS Jacob Tremblay, Kate McKinnon, Ego Nwodim, Chabely Ponce
 BUZZ A teen comedy about two slackers at the opposite ends of their high school’s social spectrum forced to work together to try and graduate. With few mainstream comedies on offer in the market, this could be the one to get buyers to open up.
 SALES Upgrade, UTA Independent Film Group, After Hours
 ‘In Her Shadow’
 Image Credit: Paras Griffin/Getty Images for ESSENCE 
 In Her Shadow 
 DIRECTOR Rowan Athale
 STARS Letitia Wright
 BUZZ This supernatural horror thriller sees Black Panther: Wakanda Forever star Wright playing Annie Cutter, a celebrated author who adopts the daughter of her estranged, recently-deceased sister, a girl her sister kept locked in a basement for five years. But after taking the girl in, Cutter begins to suspect her sister may have had a reason to be afraid of the child.
 SALES Bankside Films
 ‘The Journeyman’
 Image Credit: John Parra, Francois G. Durand 
 The Journeyman 
 DIRECTOR Ángel Manuel Soto
 STARS Patrick Schwarzenegger, Leslie Grace
 BUZZ Blue Beetle director Soto pivots to sports-crime with this story of a down-on-his-luck tennis pro who is drawn into the dark world of match-fixing as he tries to make ends meet for his family. Schwarzenegger and Grace lead the cast.
 SALES AGC Studios, WME, UTA
 ‘The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd’
 Image Credit: Benoit Soler 
 The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd 
 DIRECTOR Tim Blake Nelson
 STARS Amanda Seyfried, Scoot McNairy
 BUZZ Based on true events, this drama, which premiered to strong reviews in Toronto , follows an English teacher trapped in an abusive marriage who takes a job at a maximum-security prison in Oklahoma and falls for a charismatic inmate who is also a student in her class.
 SALES WestEnd Films
 ‘ Mare Nostrum ‘
 Image Credit: Courtesy of HanWay 
 Mare Nostrum 
 DIRECTORS Mariano Cohn and Gastón Duprat
 STAR Antonio Banderas
 BUZZ This feature, from the Argentine directors of Official Competition (2021) should have potential beyond the Spanish-language market. Banderas stars as a container ship captain who takes on a boat of African migrants, only to land in a political storm when he tries to dock in Europe.
 SALES HanWay
 ‘The Portrait’
 Image Credit: Samir Hussein, Michael Loccisano 
 The Portrait 
 DIRECTOR Sarah Colangelo
 STARS Gillian Anderson, Rebecca Hall
 BUZZ A pitch for a more adult demographic, this new project from Colangelo, director of The Kindergarten Teacher (2018) is billed as a Hitchcockian thriller about an acclaimed writer (Anderson) who for years has been having an affair with a married man. When he is struck ill and she can’t see him anymore, the writer commissions his artist wife (Hall), to paint her portrait, setting up a showdown between the two women.
 SALES Rocket Science, WME
 ‘Safe Space’
 Image Credit: Lisa O'CONNOR / AFP, Aurore Marechal 
 Safe Space 
 DIRECTOR Gillian Wallace Horvat
 STARS Joey King, LaKeith Stanfield
 BUZZ Dating is hard enough without an alien. In this high-concept sci-fi comedy from I Blame Society director Horvat, an intelligent but insecure scientist escapes a toxic relationship with a co-worker, only to rebound into what may be the most toxic relationship in the galaxy: an affair with a gorgeous alien.
 SALES Lucky Number, WME, CAA
 ‘Speed The Plow’
 Image Credit: David Livingston/Getty Images 
 Speed the Plow 
 DIRECTOR David Mamet
 STARS Anthony Mackie, Sharon Stone, Ben Mendelsohn, Emily Alyn Lind
 BUZZ Hollywood inside baseball from Mamet, who revisits the town’s power games in this black comedy about a newly appointed studio chief offered a guaranteed blockbuster — or an important art-house film championed by his office temp. The choice becomes a test of professional ambition and personal integrity.
 SALES The Solution Entertainment Group
 ‘Untitled Armando Iannucci Package’
 Image Credit: Jeff Kravitz/FilmMagic 
 Untitled Armando Iannucci Package 
 DIRECTOR Armando Iannucci
 STARS Taron Egerton, Alicia Vikander, James McAvoy
 BUZZ The award-winning writer/director of Veep and The Death of Stalin is trying his hand at the conspiracy thriller in this hot project. Plot details are being kept under wraps but the A-list cast, and Iannucci’s pedigree, should bring buyers in.
 SALES FilmNation Entertainment, UTA Independent Film Group
 ‘Violet’
 Image Credit: Amy Sussman, Kayla Oaddams, Taylor Hill 
 Violet 
 DIRECTOR Patrick Brice
 STARS Lili Reinhart, Danny Ramirez, Suki Waterhouse, Mark Duplass, Lukas Gage
 BUZZ A horror thriller with a tech edge, this feature from Creep director Brice follows a widower Sean (Ramirez) trying to move on after the death of his fiancée, Violet (Waterhouse). He finds new love with his childhood friend (Reinhart). But then Sean begins to receive unsettling text messages from someone, or something, claiming to be dead ex. someone, or something, claiming to be his dead ex.
 SALES FilmNation Entertainment
